Anant Singh Daughter Wedding : anant sinh ke ghar shahi shadi ka jashn shuru | Shivangi Singh | Mokama
Bihar ke charchit vidhayak anant sinh ki chhoti putri shivangi sinh ki shadi ko lekar taiyariyan puri ho chuki hain...unke paitrik aavas ladvan men shadi ki paranprik rasmen vidhi-vidhan ke sath puri ki gaeen...patna ke ek niji hotal men shivangi sinh ka tilak samaroh aayojit kiya gaya hai...tilak charhane se pahle kanya shivangi sinh rashm kiya gaya
